div.head: As Alm 2
div.ab: ⁊ gif se gereafa ðis oferheald, gebete XXX scill., ⁊ sie þæt feoh gedæled ðæm ðearfum ðe on ða tun synd, ðe ðis ungefremed wunie, on ðæs bisceopes gewitnesse.
Et si prepositus hoc superteneat, emendet triginta sol., et diuidatur hęc pecunia per testimonium episcopi pauperibus qui in ipsa uilla sunt, ubi hoc non fuerit executum.
⁊ gif gereafa ðis oferheald, gebete XXX scill., ⁊ sie þæt feoh gedæled ðæm ðearfum ðe on ða tun synd, ðe ðis ungefremed wunie, on ðæs bisceopes gewitnesse.

And if the reeve neglects [to do] this, he shall pay 30 shillings compensation, and the money shall be divided, with the cognisance of the bishop, among the poor who are on the estate where [this] remains unfulfilled.

Und wenn der [königliche] Vogt dies versäumt, büsse er 30 Schill., und werde dies Geld unter Zeugniss des Bischofs den Armen vertheilt, die in jenem Herrschaftsbezirke sind, wo dies unausgeführt geblieben ist.

And if the [royal] reeve neglects this, let him pay 30 shillings in compensation, and let this money be distributed, under the witness of the bishop, to the poor who are in that estate where this has remained undone.
div.note: II As follows in both Ld and Quadr.
